title: A key without a colon whose text runs over two lines gets its value after the text
notes: yaml-test-suite 8KB6. The plain key `multi line` is folded over two lines and has no colon. The pointer token is its folded text. The value goes after the last line of the key. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md).

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend wrote `line2`; the native backend wrote the colon and value after the key text.
